verdict.reasons: Core defect: the image features thick black supply pipes rather than drip tape, and specifically displays a visible gap between pipe sections instead of the required closed ribbed compression union installed inline with visible joined ends and seal. While the required AFP packaging and watermarks are present and authentic, the total absence of the specified technical connection evidence makes the image a poor illustration for an article dedicated to inspecting drip tape connections.

focused_physical_review.reason: Visual evidence confirms a broad, uninterrupted soil gap around the complete footprint of the AFP package, including the rear. The black irrigation line maintains a clear distance from the package, not touching or crossing its base. There are no additional loose coils visible on the soil. The package sides and base are smooth and intact, showing no protruding ribbons, straps, or tape tails.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
